# CRAPS - R.G. Davis - DREAMER 15 p.10 (PDF page 12) - CHIP-8 + 6800, 0080-03FF, run C000
# Two dice, thrown by pressing any key. First throw: 7 or 11 wins, 2, 3 or 12 loses; any other
# total becomes your 'point', then the dice are thrown again until you throw your point (win)
# or a 7 (lose). The four 64x5 messages at 0360-03FF are copied to the screen by the 6800
# routine 02D9-0313 (entries 02ED/02F3/02F9/02FF; 02D8/02DB/02DE are its workspace).
